falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes below $58,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakdown below the key support level would invalidate the HOLD signal and the mini_top_2019_jun pattern match, indicating the blowoff top thesis is wrong and a deeper correction or bearish reversal is underway.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on major perpetual swaps (Binance/OKX) turns negative for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent negative funding would show shorts are paying longs, contradicting the overheated long positioning implied by the 56 blowoff score and suggesting the market is not in a euphoric top phase but rather in distribution or fear.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC dominance drops below 48% while ETH/BTC ratio rises above 0.065
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rotation into altcoins with Bitcoin losing dominance would invalidate the macro top pattern, as blowoff tops typically see Bitcoin dominance rising into the peak, not falling; this would suggest a risk-on alt season rather than a market-wide top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
